''See also: [[Slumbering Wraith Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Slumbering Wraith, also known as [[Subject One]], is a powerful entity and one of the four [[Dreadgods]]. Though it can appear as a spirit or a ghost-like manifestation, it is fundamentally a [[Striker technique]] possessing its own will. The creature is defined by an insatiable [[hunger]] for all things, including death, and possesses a suction-like [[Authority|authority]] that consumes power without being satiated. As the master of a [[labyrinth]], the Wraith exerts control over its various layers and gates; its presence alone can cause massive stone doors to react. The entity's influence persists through several physical remnants, including a [[core binding]], an arm that can be attached to a person, and a horn that warps the surrounding air to transform animals into [[dreadbeasts]]. These pieces of the Wraith carry its ancient [[Authority|authority]] and [[hunger]], which can potentially consume a host or serve as an anchor for the entity's rebirth. While the Wraith is capable of immense destruction, it has expressed a desire to rest once the [[Monarchs]] who sustain great beasts are removed from the world. If its [[core binding]] is utilized, there is a risk of a person fusing with it to become a new version of the Slumbering Wraith, gaining immortality and power exceeding that of [[Monarchs]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Known as [[Subject One]], the Slumbering Wraith is a spirit-like [[Striker technique]] originating from the Devourer. This entity possesses an eye that can be felt and harbors a [[hunger]] for all things, including death itself. During his confrontation with the entity, [[Lindon]] encounters its echo, which provides him with a blessing. Following the encounter, the Wraith may have died or simply released its hold, leaving [[Lindon]] to occupy its throne. Ultimately, [[Lindon]] emerged from the experience with the power of the Slumbering Wraith under his control.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a [[Dreadgod]], the Slumbering Wraith served as the source for one of [[Northstrider]]'s limbs. A copy of the [[Wandering Titan]] exists from a time before the [[Dreadgods]] inherited the strength of this entity, and a stylized depiction of the Slumbering Wraith marks the largest gate into [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]. Although the Slumbering Wraith has died, it possesses a [[core binding]] that facilitates [[Lindon]]'s transformation into the entity. As part of his body is reconstructed from its essence, flesh grows out of [[Lindon]], allowing him to use the Wraith's right hand to consume [[earth madra]].}}
